brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
actually maybe this is 'old world' thinking and i can just instaspawn one (!!?). @buildthis.bisks.net make a website where you point it at a bsky thread and it returns a tiled grid of all the images uploaded to that thread

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@norvid-studies.bsky.social: @minormobius.bsky.social @carbonadoks.com is there currently a page that pulls all the images from one thread, into a single tiled image?
note: threadtiles: paste any post link from a bsky thread and get every image in it (parents + all replies) as one tiled grid. Tweak size/gap/crop, download or share.
